title.zh: 卷205 表四十五 疆臣年表九 各边将军都统大臣
title.en: Volume 205 Tables 45: Provincial Officials Chronological Table 9, Frontier Generals, Lieutenant Generals, and Ministers
title.raw: 卷205 表四十五 疆臣年表九 各边将军都统大臣

sentences.zh: 康熙元年壬寅，設鎭守遼東等處將軍、鎭守寧古塔等處將軍。

translations.literal: Kangxi 1st year, year renyin: the General for Garrisoning Liaodong and Other Places and the General for Garrisoning Ningguta and Other Places were established.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 1 (1662), year renyin, the posts of General for Garrisoning Liaodong and Other Places and General for Garrisoning Ningguta and Other Places were created.

sentences.zh: 自鎭守盛京昂邦將軍爲鎭守遼東等處將軍。

translations.literal: From the General for Garrisoning Shengjing, titled Angbang General, [the office became] the General for Garrisoning Liaodong and Other Places.
translations.idiomatic: The Shengjing garrison Angbang General was redesignated General for Garrisoning Liaodong and Other Places.

sentences.zh: 順治十六年以昂邦將軍駐防，是年陞鎭守寧古塔等處將軍。

translations.literal: In Shunzhi 16 he was garrisoned as Angbang General; that same year he was promoted to General for Garrisoning Ningguta and Other Places.
translations.idiomatic: He had been stationed as Angbang General since Shunzhi 16; in that same year he was promoted to General for Garrisoning Ningguta and Other Places.

sentences.zh: 五月辛巳，鎭守遼東等處將軍。六月己未改鎭守奉天等處將軍。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day xinsi: General for Garrisoning Liaodong and Other Places. Sixth month, day jiwei: changed to General for Garrisoning Fengtian and Other Places.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on day xinsi, he was made General for Garrisoning Liaodong and Other Places; in the sixth month, on day jiwei, the title was changed to General for Garrisoning Fengtian and Other Places.

translations.literal: Ninth month, day gengzi: made Fengtian General.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on day gengzi, he was appointed Fengtian General.

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiyou: made Fengtian General.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on day jiyou, he was appointed Fengtian General.

sentences.zh: 卒，予祭葬。十二月乙丑以正黃旗副都統爲奉天將軍。

translations.literal: He died; funeral sacrifices and burial honors were granted. Twelfth month, day yichou: a Vice Commander-in-Chief of the Plain Yellow Banner was made Fengtian General.
translations.idiomatic: He died and was granted state funeral rites and burial honors. In the twelfth month, on day yichou, a vice commander-in-chief of the Plain Yellow Banner was appointed Fengtian General.

sentences.zh: 七月甲寅解任。爲奉天將軍。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day jiayin: relieved of office. [Another was] made Fengtian General.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on day jiayin, he was relieved of his post; another officer was appointed Fengtian General.

sentences.zh: 康熙二十二年癸亥，九月設黑龍江將軍。

translations.literal: Kangxi 22nd year, year guihai; ninth month: Heilongjiang General was established.
translations.idiomatic: Kangxi 22 (1683), year guihai: in the ninth month the post of Heilongjiang General was created.

translations.literal: First month, day xinsi: made Fengtian General.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month, on day xinsi, he was appointed Fengtian General.

sentences.zh: 罷。八月庚子，爲寧古塔將軍。

translations.literal: Dismissed. Eighth month, day gengzi: made Ningguta General.
translations.idiomatic: He was dismissed. In the eighth month, on day gengzi, he was appointed Ningguta General.

sentences.zh: 十月癸亥爲黑龍江將軍。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day guihai: made Heilongjiang General.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on day guihai, he was appointed Heilongjiang General.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛未遷。貝勒十二月庚寅爲奉天將軍。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day xinwei: transferred. A beile, twelfth month, day gengyin: made Fengtian General.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on day xinwei, he was transferred. In the twelfth month, on day gengyin, a beile was appointed Fengtian General.

sentences.zh: 九月卒。十月庚戌爲奉天將軍。

translations.literal: Ninth month: died. Tenth month, day gengxu: made Fengtian General.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the ninth month. In the tenth month, on day gengxu, another officer was appointed Fengtian General.

sentences.zh: 五月壬戌革。乙亥，爲寧古塔將軍。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day renxu: dismissed from office. Day yihai: made Ningguta General.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on day renxu, he was dismissed; on day yihai he was appointed Ningguta General.
His headquarters were moved to Mergen.

translations.literal: Made General Pacifying the North, garrisoned at Guihuacheng.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed General Pacifying the North and stationed at Guihuacheng.

sentences.zh: 十月授右衛將軍，仍兼管歸化城將軍事。

translations.literal: Tenth month: appointed Youwei General, still concurrently managing the affairs of the Guihuacheng General.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month he was appointed General of the Right Guard while still concurrently overseeing the duties of the Guihuacheng general.

sentences.zh: 六月癸丑革。七月己巳爲寧古塔將軍。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day guichou: dismissed. Seventh month, day jisi: made Ningguta General.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on day guichou, he was dismissed; in the seventh month, on day jisi, he was appointed Ningguta General.

sentences.zh: 四月戊午革。四月壬午爲奉天將軍。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day wuwu: dismissed. Fourth month, day renwu: made Fengtian General.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on day wuwu, he was dismissed; on day renwu he was appointed Fengtian General.
His headquarters were moved to Qiqihar.

sentences.zh: 二月乙丑遷。爲寧古塔將軍。

translations.literal: Second month, day yichou: transferred. Made Ningguta General.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on day yichou, he was transferred and appointed Ningguta General.

sentences.zh: 二月己未革。爲黑龍江將軍。

translations.literal: Second month, day jiwei: dismissed. Made Heilongjiang General.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on day jiwei, he was dismissed and another officer was appointed Heilongjiang General.

sentences.zh: 七月丁巳休致。八月丁亥爲黑龍江將軍。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day dingsi: retired. Eighth month, day dinghai: made Heilongjiang General.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on day dingsi, he retired; in the eighth month, on day dinghai, another officer was appointed Heilongjiang General.

sentences.zh: 免。正月癸酉爲奉天將軍。

translations.literal: Dismissed. First month, day guiyou: made Fengtian General.
translations.idiomatic: He was dismissed. In the first month, on day guiyou, another officer was appointed Fengtian General.

sentences.zh: 九月庚寅遷。十一月丙申爲黑龍江將軍。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day gengyin: transferred. Eleventh month, day bingshen: made Heilongjiang General.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on day gengyin, he was transferred; in the eleventh month, on day bingshen, he was appointed Heilongjiang General.

sentences.zh: 二月己酉遷。二月戊午署奉天將軍。

translations.literal: Second month, day jiyou: transferred. Second month, day wuwu: acting Fengtian General.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on day jiyou, he was transferred; on day wuwu he was appointed acting Fengtian General.

sentences.zh: 二月己酉遷。二月己酉爲寧古塔將軍。

translations.literal: Second month, day jiyou: transferred. Second month, day jiyou: made Ningguta General.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on day jiyou, he was transferred and appointed Ningguta General.

sentences.zh: 二月乙巳革。二月己酉爲黑龍江將軍。

translations.literal: Second month, day yisi: dismissed. Second month, day jiyou: made Heilongjiang General.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on day yisi, he was dismissed; on day jiyou another officer was appointed Heilongjiang General.

sentences.zh: 十月丁巳遷。十月丁巳署奉天將軍。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day dingsi: transferred. Tenth month, day dingsi: acting Fengtian General.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on day dingsi, he was transferred and appointed acting Fengtian General.

sentences.zh: 卒。三月辛丑署寧古塔將軍。

translations.literal: Died. Third month, day xinchou: acting Ningguta General.
translations.idiomatic: He died. In the third month, on day xinchou, an acting Ningguta General was appointed.

sentences.zh: 卒。五月丙午，署黑龍江將軍。

translations.literal: Died. Fifth month, day bingwu: acting Heilongjiang General.
translations.idiomatic: He died. In the fifth month, on day bingwu, an acting Heilongjiang General was appointed.

sentences.zh: 十月戊子爲黑龍江將軍。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day wuzi: made Heilongjiang General.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on day wuzi, he was appointed Heilongjiang General.
In the seventh month he was appointed acting Heilongjiang General.

sentences.zh: 正月乙亥乞休。三月爲右衛將軍。

translations.literal: First month, day yihai: requested retirement. Third month: made Youwei General.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month, on day yihai, he asked to retire; in the third month he was appointed General of the Right Guard.

translations.literal: Second month, day jiazi: Heilongjiang General.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on day jiazi, he was appointed Heilongjiang General.

translations.literal: Minister for Managing Affairs in Tibet

sentences.zh: 十二月癸未解任。爲奉天將軍。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day guiwei: relieved of office. Made Fengtian General.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on day guiwei, he was relieved of his post; another officer was appointed Fengtian General.

sentences.zh: 二月丁未召。寧古塔將軍。

translations.literal: Second month, day dingwei: summoned. Ningguta General.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on day dingwei, he was summoned to serve as Ningguta General.

sentences.zh: 六月戊子降。爲右衛將軍。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day wuzi: demoted. Made Youwei General.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on day wuzi, he was demoted and appointed General of the Right Guard.
In the eleventh month he was transferred and appointed Fengtian General.
He was assigned to manage Qinghai affairs.

translations.literal: Second month: summoned. Made Heilongjiang General.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month he was summoned and appointed Heilongjiang General.

translations.literal: Second month: transferred. Made Youwei General.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month he was transferred and appointed General of the Right Guard.

sentences.zh: 二月卒。閏三月爲奉天將軍。

translations.literal: Second month: died. Intercalary third month: made Fengtian General.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the second month; in the intercalary third month another officer was appointed Fengtian General.

sentences.zh: 二月召。十二月爲黑龍江將軍。

translations.literal: Second month: summoned. Twelfth month: made Heilongjiang General.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month he was summoned; in the twelfth month he was appointed Heilongjiang General.

sentences.zh: 五月丁巳赴藏辦事。 正月丁巳赴藏辦事。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day dingsi: went to Tibet to manage affairs. First month, day dingsi: went to Tibet to manage affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On day dingsi in the fifth month he went to Tibet on official business; on day dingsi in the first month he went to Tibet on official business.

translations.literal: Ninth month, day guihai: dismissed. Acting.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on day guihai, he was dismissed; an acting appointment followed.

translations.literal: Second month: transferred. Made Fengtian General.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month he was transferred and appointed Fengtian General.

translations.literal: First month: demoted. Made Fengtian General.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month he was demoted and appointed Fengtian General.

translations.literal: First month: transferred. Made Heilongjiang General.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month he was transferred and appointed Heilongjiang General.

translations.literal: Returned to the capital. Managing affairs in Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: He returned to the capital and was assigned to manage Tibetan affairs.

translations.literal: First month: transferred. Made Ningguta General.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month he was transferred and appointed Ningguta General.

translations.literal: Sixth month: recalled to the capital. Managing affairs in Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month he was recalled to the capital and assigned to manage Tibetan affairs.

translations.literal: Ninth month: went to the military camp. Acting.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month he went to the army camp in an acting capacity.

translations.literal: Ninth month: transferred. Made Ningguta General.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month he was transferred and appointed Ningguta General.

translations.literal: Made Left Deputy General for Pacifying the Frontier.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Left Deputy General for Pacifying the Frontier.

sentences.zh: 八月總理青海番人事務。

translations.literal: Eighth month: put in overall charge of Qinghai Tibetan affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month he was placed in overall charge of Tibetan affairs in Qinghai.

sentences.zh: 召回京。八月赴藏辦事。尋卒。赴藏辦事。

translations.literal: Recalled to the capital. Eighth month: went to Tibet to manage affairs. Soon died. Went to Tibet to manage affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He was recalled to the capital, and in the eighth month went to Tibet on official business; he soon died. He had gone to Tibet on official business.
He was transferred and appointed Fengtian General.
He was transferred and appointed Heilongjiang General.
He was dismissed; in the twelfth month another officer was appointed General of the Right Guard.
